mentions.name: Wordazzle
mentions.description: Daily word game that delivers seven carefully chosen, sublime words designed to elevate verbal prowess, inspired by the quote 'the limits of my language are the limits of my world'. Favorite words can be saved as flashcards to review later.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://wordazzle.com: Inspired by the quote 'the limits of my language are the limits of my world,' it's a daily game delivering 7 carefully chosen, sublime words designed to genuinely elevate your verbal prowess. You can also save the words you love as flashcards to review them later!
